handlers.name: Max
handlers.effect: Stand Together: Choose 1 allied Mystic. It gains +5 ATK and +3 DEF until the start of your next turn.
handlers.duration: Until the start of your next turn
handlers.notes: Leadership-focused Handler. Activation attempt consumes the turn whether it succeeds or fails.

handlers.name: Sawyer
handlers.effect: Lucky Break: Choose 1 allied Mystic. The next failed Special Move roll it makes before the start of your following turn may be rerolled once. The reroll result must be used.
handlers.duration: Until triggered or until the start of your following turn
handlers.notes: Improvisation/comedic-risk Handler. This does not remove or bypass a Special Move cooldown.

handlers.name: Henry
handlers.effect: Awaken the Spark: Choose 1 allied Mystic. Reduce the cooldown of one of its Special Moves by 1, to a minimum of 0.
handlers.notes: Awakening-focused Handler. Can make a Special immediately available if its cooldown reaches 0. Activation attempt consumes the turn whether it succeeds or fails.

handlers.name: Mr. Alden
handlers.effect: Overcharge: Choose 1 allied Mystic. Its next attack gets +8 ATK. If that attack is a Special Move, the bonus applies only if the Special succeeds.
handlers.duration: Until that Mystic makes its next attack
handlers.notes: Older historian/bookstore figure. Electricity-themed Handler concept. Activation attempt consumes the turn whether it succeeds or fails.

handlers.name: Captain Edmund
handlers.effect: Battle Command: Choose 1 allied Mystic. It may immediately make a Basic Attack as part of this Handler action.
handlers.notes: Fighting-Mystic Handler concept. The Handler action still counts as the player's one action for the turn.

handlers.name: Amelia
handlers.effect: Crystal Ward: Choose 1 allied Mystic. It gains +6 DEF until the start of your next turn.
handlers.duration: Until the start of your next turn
handlers.notes: Historian. Crystal-Mystic Handler concept. Activation attempt consumes the turn whether it succeeds or fails.

handlers.name: Arch, The Fallen
handlers.effect: Void Dominion: Choose 1 enemy Mystic. It loses 8 DEF until the start of your next turn, and its Special Moves cannot be used on its next turn.
handlers.duration: Until the start of your next turn; Special lock affects target's next turn
handlers.notes: Primary Void-aligned Handler. Formerly Archeion, The Crowned. Strong control effect balanced by a 6-only activation.

handlers.name: Captain Vesper
handlers.effect: Marked for Ruin: Choose 1 enemy Mystic. The next time it takes damage before the start of your next turn, it takes +6 additional damage after normal damage is calculated.
handlers.duration: Until triggered or until the start of your next turn
handlers.notes: Void general/captain serving Arch. Bonus damage is added after Attack minus Defense is calculated.

handlers.name: Lieutenant Morrow
handlers.effect: Shadow Step: Choose 1 allied Mystic. The next attack that targets it before the start of your next turn deals 0 damage.
handlers.duration: Until triggered or until the start of your next turn
handlers.notes: Void lieutenant serving Arch. Prevents damage from one attack but does not cancel other non-damage effects unless explicitly stated.
